vulnerable_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # Rule ordering flaw: cannot rule defined first is overridden by subsequent blanket can rule
    cannot :manage, BankTransfer, status: 'locked'
    can :manage, BankTransfer, account: { user_id: user.id }
  end
end

class Banking::TransfersController < ApplicationController
  def cancel
    @transfer = BankTransfer.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :manage, @transfer

    @transfer.update!(status: 'cancelled')
    render json: { message: 'Transfer cancelled' }
  end
end
diagnosis: In CanCanCan, later authorization declarations take precedence over earlier ones. Declaring cannot :manage before can :manage causes the lock restriction to be completely overridden. Users can cancel locked, in-flight settlement wire transfers after funds have already been dispatched.
